headword: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}

definitions.explanation: A payment method in which the buyer pays the courier for the goods at the moment of delivery. Often abbreviated 代引き.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}にした。
examples.english: I chose cash on delivery for payment.

examples.japanese: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Cash on delivery comes with a handling fee.

examples.japanese: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}なら⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}える→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: With cash on delivery you can pay in cash when you receive the goods.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧ (payment for goods) + {引換|ひきかえ} (exchange). Commonly shortened to ⟦{代引|だいび}き→代引き：09721_daibiki⟧ in everyday speech and online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay by cash on delivery
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: the COD handling fee
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use cash on delivery
